titleEn: Count Fertile Pyramids in a Land
title: 统计农场中肥沃金字塔的数目
summary: 二进制农场中统计高度至少二、内部全为肥沃土地的正向和倒置等腰金字塔数量。
insight: 对正向金字塔从底向上 DP：若当前格肥沃，其最大高度是一加下一行左、中、右三格高度的最小值，每个高度 h 贡献 h-1 个不同金字塔。上下翻转后再算一次得到倒置数量。
pitfalls: 金字塔内部也必须全一
一个高金字塔同时包含多个较小同顶点金字塔

solutions.title: 双方向金字塔高度 DP
solutions.idea: 分别计算向下与向上的最大连续高度。
steps: 原网格 count 得正向
翻转行顺序再 count 得倒置，二者相加

code.java: class Solution { private int count(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length,answer=0;int[][] height=new int[rows][cols];for(int row=rows-1;row>=0;row--)for(int col=0;col<cols;col++)if(grid[row][col]==1){height[row][col]=1;if(row+1<rows&&col>0&&col+1<cols)height[row][col]+=Math.min(height[row+1][col],Math.min(height[row+1][col-1],height[row+1][col+1]));answer+=height[row][col]-1;}return answer;}public int countPyramids(int[][] grid){int answer=count(grid);for(int top=0,bottom=grid.length-1;top<bottom;top++,bottom--){int[] temporary=grid[top];grid[top]=grid[bottom];grid[bottom]=temporary;}return answer+count(grid);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun count(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val cols=grid[0].size;val height=Array(rows){IntArray(cols)};var answer=0;for(row in rows-1 downTo 0)for(col in 0 until cols)if(grid[row][col]==1){height[row][col]=1;if(row+1<rows&&col>0&&col+1<cols)height[row][col]+=minOf(height[row+1][col-1],height[row+1][col],height[row+1][col+1]);answer+=height[row][col]-1};return answer};fun countPyramids(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val answer=count(grid);grid.reverse();return answer+count(grid)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int countPyramidsOne(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),cols=grid[0].size(),answer=0;vector<vector<int>> height(rows,vector<int>(cols));for(int row=rows-1;row>=0;--row)for(int col=0;col<cols;++col)if(grid[row][col]){height[row][col]=1;if(row+1<rows&&col&&col+1<cols)height[row][col]+=min({height[row+1][col-1],height[row+1][col],height[row+1][col+1]});answer+=height[row][col]-1;}return answer;}public: int countPyramids(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int answer=countPyramidsOne(grid);reverse(grid.begin(),grid.end());return answer+countPyramidsOne(grid);} };
